extracted.intended_audience: public information officers (PIOs), communications staff at research organizations, and other contributors submitting news releases/multimedia to EurekAlert!
extracted.subtask_description: Eligibility and content rules for submitting news releases, multimedia releases, media advisories, feature stories, article highlights, and press summaries to the EurekAlert! distribution platform. Covers timeliness, embargoes, membership, acceptable content types, multimedia licensing, AI policy, and ineligible content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeliness (90-day rule)
rubrics_metrics.description: All news releases, multimedia releases, and media advisories submitted to EurekAlert! must describe information first made public within 90 days of content submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a cited publication has online and print publication dates, EurekAlert! can consider whichever date is more recent. Content submitted outside the 90-day window is ineligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embargo policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Content may be submitted with a news embargo only if the embargo is set by the journal publisher or the organizer of a scientific meeting and/or press event where the information will first be publicly released.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content may not carry an embargo if the information is publicly available at the time of submission or is not related to a publication, meeting, or press event. EurekAlert! may reject, re-categorize, or request clarifications on embargo times and publication dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Membership/subscription requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Only PIO-members with an active content submission subscription may submit eligible news releases, multimedia releases, media advisories, feature stories, and article highlights.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press Summaries are exclusive to organizations that host Press Packages in the reporter-only section on EurekAlert!. For journal Press Packages or News Portals, contact business[AT]eurekalert[DOT]org.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer-Reviewed Publications (eligible news release type)
rubrics_metrics.description: News releases that describe information that has undergone validation by peer review are eligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: research studies published in a peer-reviewed journal; clinical trial results that have completed peer review; editorials, commentaries, or analyses that have undergone peer review and are published in a peer-reviewed journal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reports and Proceedings (eligible news release type)
rubrics_metrics.description: News releases that describe information produced by a credible, recognized organization or through well-recognized scientific processes but not intended for peer-reviewed publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: research results presented at scientific meetings; editorials/commentaries not subject to peer review but published in a peer-reviewed journal; government/agency reports, white papers; advancement or conclusion of a clinical trial phase with preliminary results; scientifically validated survey/polling data or image analysis (e.g., satellite, telescope); new databases or resources made publicly available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Business Announcements (eligible news release type)
rubrics_metrics.description: News releases describing information that is primarily transactional or not intended for further validation by peer review are eligible under 'Business Announcements.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: collaborations, mergers, agreements; start of a new clinical trial or calls for participation; regulatory approval, licensing, or patenting; forecasts/trends or economic developments; developments in scientific publishing; administrative/business announcements with societal or industry-wide impacts; science-related public awareness or educational campaigns; evidence-based policy announcements or official position statements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meeting Announcements (eligible news release type)
rubrics_metrics.description: News releases that describe timely information about scientific meetings are eligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes logistical or programmatic information about upcoming meetings open to media/public where new information will be presented, and summaries or highlights of recently held meetings that were open to media/public.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant and Award Announcements (eligible news release type)
rubrics_metrics.description: News releases describing grant funding, awards, honors, and related calls are eligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: new or renewed grant funding, awards, honors (including fellowships) and their societal/industry impact; calls for grant proposals, award nominations, or applications and their significance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Book Announcements (eligible news release type)
rubrics_metrics.description: News releases that describe publication of new science-related books, manuals, or textbooks are eligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended for release announcements of science-related publications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multimedia Release (format & submission requirements)
rubrics_metrics.description: A multimedia release consists primarily of one or a collection of up to seven images, videos, and/or audio clips accompanied by an introduction and captions; may be submitted without a conventional news release narrative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multimedia releases must offer enough information for EurekAlert! staff to judge eligibility. Standalone multimedia may be submitted to the Multimedia Gallery by selecting 'Multimedia Release' and can include up to seven items, each with a title and brief caption.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multimedia licensing and third-party use requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: All multimedia submitted must be cleared for third-party use; multimedia from stock image sites are ineligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For further details and a breakdown of accepted multimedia license types, consult EurekAlert!'s SciComm blog and multimedia policies. Documentation of transferable rights may be required in exceptional cases (e.g., some AI exceptions).

rubrics_metrics.name: AI-generated content policy
rubrics_metrics.description: AI-generated text, images, and other multimedia are not eligible for submission and distribution on EurekAlert!, with limited exceptions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exceptions (e.g., for images/videos in research publications specifically about AI/ML) may be granted case-by-case and must be disclosed at submission. In all exceptions, documentation showing transferable rights to the AI-generated image/multimedia is required. Policy may change as law and standards evolve.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Advisory eligibility and content requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Media advisories are available only to journalist-members logged in and must contain information that meets at least one specified criterion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acceptable criteria include: information about an upcoming physical or virtual press event (press conference, briefing, teleconference, media tour) where new scientific research is being released; availability of one or more experts for press interviews; expert lists and Q&A transcripts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ineligible content types
rubrics_metrics.description: News releases are ineligible if they contain certain types of content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples of ineligible content: research results undergoing but not completed peer review (working papers, preprints); editorials/commentaries/op-eds/letters based mainly on individual opinion not published in a peer-reviewed journal or unsupported by new peer-reviewed research or a recent review; speeches/open letters and other materials not written in a media release format. Additionally, in rare cases EurekAlert! may deem content inappropriate if it appears to promote biased findings, raise unanswered conflict-of-interest questions, or carry an advocacy agenda unfounded in scientific research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Feature Stories eligibility and display rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Feature Stories cover 'evergreen' science-related content and have a distinctive template separate from News Releases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible examples: scientist profiles, overviews of research, updates/chronicles of research projects, Q&As/interviews, stories about initiatives or educational programs, and other storytelling-format science content. Feature Stories are publicly accessible through search and the Features and Articles Portal, are not displayed through News Release feeds, and are not distributed via email alerts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article Highlights eligibility and display rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Article Highlights describe peer-reviewed research studies published in a scholarly journal at any time and use a distinctive template.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Article Highlights are publicly accessible via search and the Features and Articles Portal, are not displayed in News Release feeds, and are not distributed via email alerts. Organizations with dedicated news portals may opt to display Article Highlights in addition to News Releases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press Summaries access and exclusivity
rubrics_metrics.description: Press Summaries are brief synopses of peer-reviewed research studies and are only available to journalist-members while accessing the respective journal Press Package or News Portal on EurekAlert!.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press Summaries are exclusive to organizations that host Press Packages in the reporter-only section; for hosting info contact EurekAlert! business staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: EurekAlert staff role and contributor responsibility
rubrics_metrics.description: EurekAlert! and its staff do not produce or alter content submissions (except to meet site-wide formatting guidelines) and do not perform peer- or scientific review on information contained therein; contributing organizations are solely responsible for accuracy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EurekAlert! and AAAS are not responsible for the accuracy of content posted by contributing institutions or for the use of any information through the website. EurekAlert! reserves the right to reject, re-categorize, or request clarifications on submissions, including embargo times and publication dates, based on the eligibility guidelines.
